exposure: Scoring system (based on serum human chorionic gonadotropin level, gestational week, and ultrasound findings)
outcome: Success of single-dose methotrexate treatment for ectopic pregnancy
Failure of single-dose methotrexate treatment for ectopic pregnancy
cohort: The study included 156 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy who received single-dose methotrexate treatment between January 2012 and December 2023.
finding: A new scoring system, with an optimal cut-off value of 2.5, significantly enhanced the ability to predict the success of single-dose methotrexate therapy for ectopic pregnancy, increasing the success rate from 75% to 90.5% for patients scoring below the cut-off.
